_comment: Regression test draft handoff for TEST-PREP: pipeline. Final instance: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/<EPIC-KEY>-tests.json. Pair with <KEY>-tests.md. Do not reference epics/<KEY>/temp/ in durable JSON. Full draft prose: one subprocess per test_bundles[] row (see .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md phase 8b). Step format norms: docs/tc-ref and docs/temp/tc-template.txt. No Playwright/DB/SSH in v1.
taxonomy_note: Internal workflow: compliance/coverage checklist first; Jira 'regression' type is client-facing taxonomy. Draft bundles are E2E combinatoric human-executable tests that operationalize the checklist. See QAPORTAL Test Repository (page 497097317) via Confluence.

sources.note: coverage_loaded required true to run; ref_loaded/analysis_loaded optional. map_only=true: mapping + titles only, skip phase 8b subprocesses. Full drafts: one subprocess per bundle (phase 8b); durable JSON must not contain /temp/ paths.

_existing_tests_considered_item.note: reuse_recommendation set only after jira_get_issue; never invent steps from title alone

_excluded_checks_with_reason_item.evidence: pointer to coverage.explicitly_out_of_scope, checks[].ambiguity, or analysis.gaps[]

_test_bundles_item._authoring_note: subprocess_completed + completed_at set after phase 8b merge. temp_draft_file: ephemeral only during run; MUST be null in committed -tests.json—never persist paths under temp/.
_test_bundles_item._draft_note: Strings may contain [TBD] or [REQUIRES: source]. No invented dxCore/SQL/example output unless pasted from fetched Jira. Populated by per-bundle subprocess when not map_only.
